text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
"For this move, picture a shooting star... 
Alright."

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
O comet streaking through the dark night! 
Shine forth in brilliant splendor— 
Scintillement Flash!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I feel like I'm on fire today! Ideas 
just keep overflowing, I can't stop!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
“—And because of all that, before I knew 
it, it was already this late! I am deeply, 
terribly sorry!! How could I ever make up 
for such insolence...?!”

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Slacking off on training is unacceptable. 
I made sure to give a stern warning so 
that it wouldn't happen again.
